Subject: ClearSky POC — hands-on kickoff recap, actions, and next session

Thanks everyone for joining the session today — quick recap and owners so nothing slips through. We covered the prompt variants, routing policies, and ran the 5-minute 50 RPS burst. Key outcomes and next steps below.

Summary:
- Prompt review: we identified 3 prompts that needed clearer system instructions; we created two prompt variants to test for quality/consistency.
- Routing: configured a simple latency-first policy with a cost cap fallback; demonstrated automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant under high tail latency.
- Load validation: 50 RPS burst completed; average latency stayed within expected bounds but p99 increased under KV-warmup — Ben captured logs and trace IDs.

Action items (owner — ETA):
1) Update prompt set with variant A/B (Andrew + Clara — 2026-09-07)
2) Apply latency-first routing policy to staging (Marcus will push change; Priyom to review rollout plan — 2026-09-03)
3) Ben to share full load report (includes p50/p95/p99, error breakdown) and the trace IDs (Ben — 2026-09-02)
4) Monica to coordinate key exchange if ClearSky requests Private endpoint testing (Monica & Andrew — confirm by 2026-09-01)
5) Schedule follow-up: deep-dive on model quantization impact and 1-hour tuning session (tentative week of 2026-09-13) — calendar invite sent.

Attachments and links:
- Load results + traces: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bClearskyPOC
